tldr: 台股加權指數收 46,166.45 點、漲 0.67%，台達電、聯發科等權值股領軍。
台積電稱 AI 需求 30 年未見，2026 年營收指引年增近三成。
金管會收緊異常存款交易防詐規範，並對金控整併態度開放。
高股息 ETF 亮眼，12 檔年化配息率破 10%；安聯推 2026 年首檔台股主動式 ETF。

items.title_zh: 權值股領軍 台股加權指數收紅
items.title_en: TAIEX closes higher as heavyweights lead broad advance
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數收在 46,166.45 點，上漲 308.79 點、漲幅 0.67%，延續近期多頭氣勢。盤面由大型科技權值股帶動，早盤即開高走穩。影響上，指數在高檔區間持續墊高，顯示資金對 AI 供應鏈與權值股仍具信心，但估值偏高下追高需留意波動風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX ended the session at 46,166.45, up 308.79 points or 0.67%, extending recent gains on strength in large-cap tech. The index opened firmly and held its ground through the day, reflecting steady buying interest in weighted stocks and resilient sentiment despite elevated valuations across the AI supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台達電、聯發科齊揚 權值股撐盤
items.title_en: Tech blue chips power market with Delta and MediaTek surging
items.summary_zh: 盤面權值股表現強勢，台達電漲逾 4%、聯發科上揚逾 3%、鴻海漲逾 2%、國巨勁揚約 7%，台積電則在 2,400 至 2,415 元間走穩。影響上，AI 相關個股領漲凸顯大盤動能高度集中於半導體與硬體供應鏈，指數走勢與這些權值龍頭連動緊密，族群輪動與資金流向值得持續關注。
items.summary_en: Index heavyweights drove the rally, with Delta Electronics up over 4%, MediaTek gaining more than 3%, Hon Hai rising over 2% and Yageo jumping around 7%, while TSMC traded firm near NT$2,400–2,415. The concentrated strength in AI-related names underscored how index performance remains tightly linked to the semiconductor and hardware supply chain.

items.title_zh: 台積電：AI需求30年未見 全球建近20座廠
items.title_en: TSMC says AI demand growth is unseen in 30 years, building nearly 20 fabs
items.summary_zh: 台積電副共同營運長侯永清在 SEMICON Taiwan 2026 表示，AI 需求成長速度為過去 30 年僅見；公司原估 2026 年設備採購金額，一季內已上修至 1.5 倍，7 月再增至 1.9 倍。台灣同步興建 13 座晶圓廠、海外 5 至 6 座，全球合計近 20 座。影響上，擴產規模創高仍追不上需求，凸顯 AI 產業鏈的強勁景氣循環。
items.summary_en: At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, TSMC deputy co-COO Y.P. Hou said AI demand is expanding faster than any period in three decades. The company's estimated 2026 equipment purchases jumped to 1.5x its late-2025 forecast in one quarter and 1.9x by July. Taiwan is building 13 fabs domestically plus five to six abroad, roughly 20 globally, still short of demand.

items.title_zh: 台積電2026營收估年增近三成 AI營收CAGR上看60%
items.title_en: TSMC guides to ~30% revenue growth for 2026 on AI boom
items.summary_zh: 台積電管理階層重申，受惠 AI 強勁需求，2026 年整體營收成長指引維持近 30%，並預估 2024 至 2029 年間 AI 相關營收複合年成長率（CAGR）將達近 60%。影響上，市場視台積電為 AI 浪潮下的結構性贏家，其先進製程產能成為全球運算基礎建設核心，長線成長動能明確，惟需留意資本支出與擴產節奏。
items.summary_en: Management reiterated guidance for near 30% overall revenue growth in 2026, driven by strong AI demand, and projects a compound annual growth rate approaching 60% for AI-related revenue from 2024 to 2029. Analysts increasingly describe TSMC as a structural winner of the AI wave, with its advanced-node capacity central to global compute buildout.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正存款帳戶異常交易管理辦法 強化防詐
items.title_en: FSC tightens rules on suspicious and abnormal deposit-account transactions
items.summary_zh: 金管會銀行局於 8 月底修正「存款帳戶及疑似不法或顯屬異常交易管理辦法」，並持續推動防詐法制、舉辦金檢警聯防高峰會。影響上，銀行對可疑帳戶與異常金流的控管標準提高，法遵與通報成本增加，但有助壓制人頭帳戶與詐騙金流，呼應監理單位將金融犯罪防制列為 2026 年重點方向。
items.summary_en: The Banking Bureau amended its regulations governing deposit accounts and suspected illegal or clearly abnormal transactions, effective late August, as part of a broader anti-fraud push. Regulators are strengthening the legal framework against scams and hosting joint bank-police anti-fraud summits, signaling continued supervisory focus on financial-crime prevention across the banking system.

items.title_zh: 彭金隆：4條件樂見金控整併 保險雙接軌如期上路
items.title_en: FSC chief open to financial-holding mergers under four conditions
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆受訪指出，在符合四項條件前提下樂見金控整併，並確認保險業「雙接軌」（IFRS 17 與 ICS）將於 2026 年如期推動。影響上，監理對金控整併態度轉趨開放，可能牽動業界併購布局；同時保險業面臨接軌新制的資本與財報衝擊，資本強化與商品結構調整將是後續觀察重點。
items.summary_en: In an interview, FSC Chairman Peng Jin-lung said the regulator welcomes financial-holding consolidation provided four conditions are met, and confirmed the insurance sector's dual accounting convergence (IFRS 17 and ICS) will proceed as scheduled in 2026. The comments point to a more receptive stance on industry consolidation alongside a major regulatory overhaul for insurers.
items.source_name: 關鍵評論網 The News Lens

items.title_zh: 高股息ETF績效亮眼 12檔年化配息率破10%
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs shine as a dozen post double-digit annualized yields
items.summary_zh: 台股高股息 ETF 績效榜出爐，本周有 25 檔台股 ETF 除息，其中 12 檔年化配息率突破 10%，反映存股與收益型商品需求熱絡。影響上，高配息題材持續吸引散戶資金，但年化配息率須以填息與配息可持續性為前提，投資人應留意成分股殖利率與淨值波動，避免僅追逐帳面高息而忽略總報酬。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's high-dividend ETF performance rankings showed strong results, with 25 domestic equity ETFs going ex-dividend this week and 12 of them delivering annualized distribution rates above 10%. The data highlights sustained retail demand for income-oriented products, though investors are reminded that headline yields depend on price stability and payout sustainability.
items.source_name: 經濟日報 財富管理

items.title_zh: 安聯首檔2026台股主動式ETF 00993A LINE Bank獨家預購
items.title_en: Allianz launches Taiwan's first active equity ETF of 2026 with LINE Bank pre-order
items.summary_zh: 安聯投信推出 2026 年全市場首檔台股主動式 ETF（00993A），並由 LINE Bank 獨家開放全市場預購。主動式 ETF 允許經理人不受指數權重限制、爭取超額報酬。影響上，此舉反映台灣投資人對交易所掛牌、具主動選股能力的財富管理商品需求升溫，主動式 ETF 產品線擴張，為市場提供有別於被動指數的資產配置選項。
items.summary_en: Allianz Global Investors rolled out the market's first actively managed Taiwan equity ETF for 2026 (00993A), with LINE Bank offering exclusive market-wide pre-ordering. Active ETFs let managers deviate from index weightings to seek excess returns, and the launch signals growing appetite among Taiwan investors for actively managed, exchange-listed wealth products.
items.source_name: 經濟日報 基金天地
